svg.text: Each row is one exploited vulnerability the sensors see attacked, the 16 busiest. The hollow dots are the EUVD's 90-, 30- and 7-day averages, the
filled dot is today, on a logarithmic scale. The averages are on another, undocumented scale: even a steady entry sits far right of them, so the gap is
not a jump. Jumps are measured against the entry's own record, in “Do upticks last?”; “Burst or campaign?” below shows how concentrated the
traffic is. Red rows carry the EUVD's own UPTICK flag (16 of the rows shown; 132 of all 210 entries with counts), grey is steady, green declining.
Limits: Connection counts from sensors, not victims and not the reporting route. Only 346 of 1,785 exploited entries appear in the sensors at all. The EUVD keeps no
history of these counts; the daily record started by this monitor is in “Do upticks last?” and in the last panel.
